source_reference.purpose: Full native ticker: qualification, control before capped cost, negative-fuel skip, residual radius, complete corner/easing helpers and persistence/packet callbacks

correction.old_text: Effects first; cost becomes2.25, strict loop drains two fuel to-1 and leaves.25. Current tick radius still follows pre-set running; next tick recalculates runningfalse, clears debt to0 and skips effects. This is algebra, not a live target/packet test.
correction.replacement: Effects first; accumulatedCost becomes2.25, strict loop drains two fuel from1 to-1 and leaves accumulatedCost=.25. Current tick radius still follows pre-set running. Next server tick recalculates running=false, sets only negative fuel to0, and skips entity/effect/cost branch. accumulatedCost remains.25; it is neither cleared nor settled on that skipped tick. Radius easing still runs. Future nonnegative-fuel ticks add to the retained.25, including during residual power-off operation. This is static algebra, not an executed native/packet test.
correction.scope: Any wording clears debt to0 refers neither to accumulatedCost nor an all-resource reset; only the signed fuel integer is clamped. Original wording is withdrawn as ambiguous/incorrect.

evidence.observation: fuel<0 branch writes only fuel=0, native notify and markDirty; skips entire else including cost settlement.
accumulatedCost subtraction occurs only inside the skipped else branch; strict>1 while loop leaves.25 in example.
radius phase executes after both branches and does not write accumulatedCost.
accumulatedCost is independently persisted; no stop/negative fuel reset in these methods.
